meaning: Stage 2, group 1: God is simple (ST I q.3 a.7, third proof). A composite has a uniting cause of its being other than itself, which by Metaphysics II.1 is more a being than it; God is maximal in being, so not composite. Unlike FIRST-MOVER-SIMPLE it does not need the bare STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING.
